decisions.statement: A member goes with the line that member sits on.
The members the type keeps are left as those members were.
The type the member named loses its import in the same answer.
A type the body names somewhere else keeps its import.
An import naming other types loses that one name rather than the whole line.
A member the type has none of is refused rather than passed over.
The object type is found through the alias the change names.
An alias built from an intersection is read for the object type inside it.
A body with no such alias is refused.
The body is answered rather than written.
Nothing here puts the imports in order.
A type written on one line loses its member on that line rather than losing a line.
A type keeps its braces when the last member goes.

definition: one member taken out of an exported object type
